$comment: The menu painting's moving pieces, cut from video takes made by apps/web/scripts/motion.mjs and turned into clips by apps/web/scripts/menu-motion.mjs. Places are pixels of designs/art/bg-no-logo.png (1024 wide). Listed bottom to top: a later piece is drawn over an earlier one. `loop` plays without end (closed with a `crossfade` of that many seconds, or none for a take that ends where it began); otherwise the piece plays through once every `every` seconds (give or take `jitter`), first at `first`. A take's `view` is the part of the scene its frames show (Seedance cut the middle square out of what it was sent); `stretch` draws that many of its top rows out to the scene's top, where the view stops short of it. `mask`: rect (soft edges, hard at the painting's border), water (only the falling water), or a polygon to cut along.
